$comment: Observed fields are written by scripts/verify_servers.py, which launches each server and records what it saw. Entries are keyed by official MCP registry name, since that is what the browser matches against. Do not hand-edit status/toolCount/lastVerified: an entry is worth something only because a machine checked it.
